milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a chiseled quartz block with a pickaxe causes it to drop itself as an item, which the player then picks up into their inventory. The player starts with no chiseled_quartz_block in inventory (verified via sandbox inventory screenshot), so having one confirms the block was successfully mined and collected. This is preferred over mine_block event or voxel checking because it directly confirms the item was obtained.
